scientific_integrity: The known unperturbed Johnson binary-rank result is attributed to Peeters. No third-party theorem is represented as a new result. The defect-induced attractor and exact transient census are independently proved in the accompanying result, with finite computational corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one deleted edge in J(n,k), with n even at least 4 and k even between 2 and n-2; other graph families and parity classes are unproved. Historical equivalence outside inspected literature is possible.
title: One-edge defects create universal six-cycles in nilpotent Johnson parity dynamics
